import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import shapiro, ttest_ind, mannwhitneyu
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter, CoxPHFitter
from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test

# Step 1: Load data
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')

# Step 2: Compute Tumor Mutational Burden (TMB) per patient
mut['patient_id'] = mut['patient_id'].str.slice(0, 12)
tmb = mut.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='TMB')

# Step 3: Prepare clinical ethnicity groups
clin = clin.rename(columns={'submitter_id': 'patient_id'})
# Map exact categories to two groups
eth_map = {
    'HISPANIC OR LATINO': 'Hispanic',
    'NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO': 'Non-Hispanic'
}
clin['ethnicity_group'] = clin['ethnicity'].map(eth_map)
# Filter out missing or other categories
clin = clin.dropna(subset=['ethnicity_group'])

# Step 5: Merge clinical with TMB
data = pd.merge(clin, tmb, on='patient_id', how='inner')

# Step 6: Filter groups with sufficient sample size (>=10)
group_counts = data['ethnicity_group'].value_counts()
valid_groups = group_counts[group_counts >= 10].index.tolist()
data = data[data['ethnicity_group'].isin(valid_groups)]

# Deliverable: Table of group sizes
print("Group sizes by ethnicity:")
print(data['ethnicity_group'].value_counts(), "\n")

# Step 7: Descriptive statistics for TMB and boxplot
tmb_summary = data.groupby('ethnicity_group')['TMB'].describe()
print("TMB summary by ethnicity:")
print(tmb_summary, "\n")

plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
data.boxplot(column='TMB', by='ethnicity_group')
plt.title('TMB by Ethnicity')
plt.suptitle('')
plt.xlabel('Ethnicity Group')
plt.ylabel('TMB (mutation count)')
plt.show()

# Step 8: Statistical test for TMB differences
g_h = data[data['ethnicity_group'] == 'Hispanic']['TMB']
g_nh = data[data['ethnicity_group'] == 'Non-Hispanic']['TMB']
# Test for normality
g1_p = shapiro(g_h)[1] if len(g_h) >= 3 else 0
g2_p = shapiro(g_nh)[1] if len(g_nh) >= 3 else 0
if g1_p > 0.05 and g2_p > 0.05:
    stat, pval = ttest_ind(g_h, g_nh, equal_var=False)
    test_name = 't-test'
else:
    stat, pval = mannwhitneyu(g_h, g_nh, alternative='two-sided')
    test_name = 'Mann-Whitney U'
print(f"{test_name} for TMB: statistic={stat:.3f}, p-value={pval:.3g}\n")

# Step 9: Prepare survival data
data['event'] = np.where(data['vital_status'] == 'Dead', 1, 0)
data['duration'] = np.where(data['event'] == 1, data['days_to_death'], data['days_to_last_followup'])
data = data.dropna(subset=['duration'])

# Step 10: Kaplan-Meier curves and log-rank test
kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
plt.figure(figsize=(7,6))
for grp_name, grp_df in data.groupby('ethnicity_group'):
    kmf.fit(grp_df['duration'], event_observed=grp_df['event'], label=grp_name)
    kmf.plot_survival_function(ci_show=False)
plt.title('Kaplan-Meier Survival by Ethnicity')
plt.xlabel('Days')
plt.ylabel('Survival Probability')
plt.legend(title='Ethnicity')
# Log-rank test
hisp = data[data['ethnicity_group']=='Hispanic']
nonh = data[data['ethnicity_group']=='Non-Hispanic']
lr_res = logrank_test(hisp['duration'], nonh['duration'], event_observed_A=hisp['event'], event_observed_B=nonh['event'])
print(f"Log-rank test p-value: {lr_res.p_value:.3g}\n")
plt.show()

# Step 11: Cox proportional hazards model
# Log2-transform TMB
data['log2_TMB1'] = np.log2(data['TMB'] + 1)
# Use age_at_diagnosis and AJCC stage proxy if available; default to clark_level
data = data.dropna(subset=['age_at_diagnosis', 'clark_level'])
cox_df = data[['duration', 'event', 'log2_TMB1', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'clark_level', 'ethnicity_group']]
cox_df = pd.get_dummies(cox_df, columns=['clark_level', 'ethnicity_group'], drop_first=True)

cph = CoxPHFitter()
cph.fit(cox_df, duration_col='duration', event_col='event')
print("Cox model summary:")
print(cph.summary, "\n")

# Step 12: Check proportional hazards assumptions
diagnostics = cph.check_assumptions(cox_df, p_value_threshold=0.05, show_plots=False)
